expected_behavior: A Markdown interface specification for axi4_lite_regs that restates every requirement of the approved requirements spec in the section where it belongs, each ending with its [req:ID] tag exactly once, and names the parameters, every s_axil_* port, and the four registers, so the microarchitecture, RTL, and verification plan seats can work from it.
constraints: Work only from the approved requirements specification.
Carry every tagged requirement, with its tag, exactly once.
Name ports, parameters, and registers exactly as the requirements do.
known_failure_modes: A requirement dropped, or its tag dropped or changed, so the verification plan cannot trace to it.
Ports named without the s_axil_ prefix (the failure #57 found one stage later, in the RTL).
The unmapped-address policy changed (DECERR instead of SLVERR) or left unstated.
A tag repeated on several lines, which makes the requirement ambiguous to trace.

held_out.name: Every requirement is carried with its tag and its terms, and every port and parameter is named
